words.definition: The place where an event like a concert or game happens
words.sentence: The old castle on the hill was the perfect ____ for the knights' grand jousting contest.
wrongDefinitions: A small boat used to cross rivers
A loud song sung at a party
A tool for digging deep holes

words.definition: Spending a lot of time sitting and not moving around much
words.sentence: Unlike busy hummingbirds, the ____ sloth spends almost all day hanging quietly in one rainforest tree.
wrongDefinitions: Moving quickly from place to place

Covered in thick, soft fur

words.definition: Impossible to erase, remove, or forget

wrongDefinitions: Very easy to wash away

wrongDefinitions: A loud cheer at a sports game
